items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-09-18
items.q: Yeah, well Jill brought us some more tickets.

ctx.x: Oh, I can't believe that. She told me she sold over 100 when I was talking to her trying to get that.
Yeah, well Jill brought us some more tickets.
Anyway, you mentioned ball. That just happened was one of the things I was going to talk to you about. Did the kids play ball much then?
